verdict.rationale: Gram's tool logs are described as 'one exportable record' of every tool call [gram-docs-29], and the underlying toolset sources (OpenAPI documents, TypeScript Functions, SKILL.md manifests) are themselves open, portable formats rather than proprietary lock-in [gram-docs-1, gram-docs-6]. However there is no documentation of a comprehensive data-export mechanism covering all platform data (org config, policies, permissions, full history) or a defined 'leave the platform' workflow. Missing for 10: full account/data export tooling, documented export formats beyond tool-call logs, and an explicit data-portability/exit guarantee.
